relevantCommands.summary: Finish or undo a managed Orca server’s interrupted update, rollback or stop
notes: When a rejected build changed profile state, recover refuses rather than restart the previous build over it. --accept-changed-state --yes restores the prelaunch snapshot instead, the same as Restore in Settings > Managed servers; what the rejected build changed is discarded.
--environment names a managed Orca server this machine deployed over SSH (see `orca environment list`); it is a selector here, not a routing flag.
Runs on this machine’s Orca desktop app, the same action as Settings > Managed servers. A runtime without the SSH registry (headless `orca serve`) refuses it.

relevantCommands.summary: Send input to a live terminal
notes: For a text-plus-Enter agent prompt, the result separates input acceptance from observed submission and turn start.
--wait-submit only observes the accepted prompt for the requested duration; timeout returns the queued/input-accepted receipt and never resends.
After an ambiguous transport failure, reissue the exact command with the reported --retry-request ID. The ID is bound to the prompt payload and exact terminal process incarnation.
Older hosts accept the legacy raw input but report provider old-host and do not offer idempotent retry or submission observation.
